top_signals.title: Barrick Chairman's Planned Overhaul Meets Investor Backlash
top_signals.summary: John Thornton appeared ready last year to step down as chairman of Barrick Mining Corp. after a turbulent 12-year tenure. Instead, he seized control from his long-time CEO and is now driving a reinvention of one of the world’s largest gold producers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
